The visible cycle was a Sept 2026 start, the intake just before Fraser's, so 2027 vacancies should appear autumn 2026. Relocation only. Entry grades were not quoted because they could not be attributed to a named Caterpillar snippet.

name: Capgemini Engineering
notes: Research 20 Aug 2026: desk tag survives - the route is a software BSc with Sheffield Hallam, GBP20k, at Telford, Worthing or London. Note the Gradcracker 'opening Autumn 2026' string served for this employer is template boilerplate, not a real date.

name: Honeywell Aerospace
notes: BEST CONFIRMED HANDS-ON PLUS SOUTHERN option of the round. Yeovil, ~60mi. Level 6 apprenticeships genuinely run there - Electromechanical and R&D Engineer, both 4 years 10 months, one day a week at Yeovil College, and entry is only GCSEs plus TWO STEM A-LEVELS AT A-C, a low bar for Fraser. The site is the only Honeywell plant worldwide making aircraft life-support systems and leads the GBP14.1m ATI-funded Project STRATA. CAVEAT: check what degree a BTEC-delivered 'Level 6' actually awards.

name: Amentum
notes: Research 20 Aug 2026: note the Gradcracker 'opening Autumn 2026' string served for this employer is template boilerplate shared with Leonardo and Capgemini Engineering, not a real date.

name: Aureos
notes: NOT A CONSULTANCY 20 Aug 2026 - Aureos is the former KELTBRAY INFRASTRUCTURE SERVICES, a GBP366.4m rail, overhead-line and highways contractor. That content maps to CIVIL (#1) and ELECTRICAL (#3), outdoors - potentially a strong fit. But four searches failed to establish level, title, provider, salary or ANY LOCATION. HIGHEST INFORMATION VALUE PER PHONE CALL anywhere in the project.

name: RINA Consulting
notes: Research 20 Aug 2026: no apprenticeship route found, searches listed. LIVE TRAP: rina.org.uk is the ROYAL INSTITUTION OF NAVAL ARCHITECTS, a different organisation entirely, and its 'Partner Universities' page surfaced during searches - do not conflate them.

name: DNV
notes: SITE-EXPOSURE TEST OVERTURNED THE DESK ASSUMPTION 20 Aug 2026. Its one apprenticeship is Electro-mechanical Level 6 with the UNIVERSITY OF WARWICK (not Nottingham - a Nottingham page surfaced in searches and was refused), 5 years, GBP20k rising GBP2k/yr, based at the SPADEADAM TEST SITE doing gas explosion and fire testing and hydrogen rigs. Genuinely plant work, and the content serves Fraser's top three disciplines better than any aerospace route in this round. But Brampton, Cumbria is ~340mi and there is ONE place. Relocation only.

name: BIP.Verco
notes: Research 20 Aug 2026 - DROP. NO apprenticeship exists at all; graduate entry only, at Bath, London or Chorley.

name: Martin-Baker
notes: RESEARCHED FROM SCRATCH 20 Aug 2026, having never been looked at before - the best NON-LOCAL mechanical option found. British manufacturer of ejection seats and aviation safety equipment, founded 1934, the world's leading producer. HQ Higher Denham near Uxbridge (~70mi, NOT commutable) on a company-owned 22-acre site, which is where the apprenticeships are; also Chalgrove Airfield (pyrotechnics) and Langford Lodge NI (rocket-sled test track). There IS a Level 6 tier, 4 years, an autumn 2027 window, and a NOTIFY OPTION. Mk16 seats selected for F-35 Lightning II. Publishes very little, so do not attempt a 'what you're working on now' paragraph from open sources.

name: SETA
notes: KEY STRUCTURAL FINDING 20 Aug 2026: SETA is the TRAINING ARM of the ExxonMobil Fawley apprenticeship - Fawley apprentices spend year one at SETA Millbrook, and ExxonMobil has funded SETA directly (GBP6,000 donation, instrumentation equipment, 'Transfer to Transform' levy transfer). SETA and Fawley are NOT competing options; they are the same route seen from two ends. No degree apprenticeship, but a real ladder: SETA delivers HNC L4 and HND L5, then university top-up to L6. Confirmed member employers: Murray Technical Services, SMC Group, Ingenieur Ltd - six further names could NOT be attributed because seta.co.uk, an unrelated North East organisation of the same name, contaminates the results. Sept 2027 interest form is the right entry point; employer vacancies from ~Jan-Feb 2027, jobs fair early Feb. Honest read: it does under-use three A-levels, but register anyway as a cheap parallel channel three miles from home. VERIFIED 20 Aug 2026: Millbrook centre opened 1969; Fawley apprentices learn welding, fitting, electrical, machining and plating there in year one, deliberately across trades to give 'extra awareness when working on site at Fawley'.

name: Sellafield Ltd
notes: Degree apprenticeships (nuclear). Autumn 2026 inferred. Register-interest live now. Cumbria - relocation.

name: Babcock International Group
notes: CONFIRMED opens October 2026 for Degree & Graduate Apprenticeships; Intermediate/Higher/Modern open December. 2027 named explicitly in their register-interest copy. No fixed close - assessment runs continually to ~May. Job alerts available - REGISTER NOW. Defence work, security clearance applies. Not yet followed on GradCracker.

name: EDF Energy
notes: Includes the Nuclear Engineering Degree Apprenticeship (NEDA). Expect late Jan 2027 - the 2026 window was 26 Jan-22 Feb, only 4 weeks. Talent Community live - join now. Register Your Interest 2027 also live on Higherin. Hinkley/Sizewell.

name: Rolls-Royce
notes: Advanced & degree (aerospace, defence, SMR). Not confirmed; expect Dec 2026-Feb 2027. Do not confuse with Rolls-Royce Motor Cars (BMW, Goodwood) - separate company. Also track Rolls-Royce SMR separately. Derby/Bristol/Birmingham.

name: UK Atomic Energy Authority
notes: Engineering/technical (fusion). CONFLICTING: site says autumn 2026 but the last two campaigns both went live in January. Watch both windows. Talent community at earlycareerstalent@ukaea.uk. Culham, Oxfordshire.

name: Sizewell C
notes: Nuclear construction & engineering. Recruits via EDF - Young SZC is Suffolk/Norfolk focused, so EDF is the better channel. No window published.

name: Ministry of Defence - Submarine Delivery Agency
notes: Degree apprenticeships exist; 2027 dates TBC. Nationality/residency gates apply - confirmed clear for Fraser.

name: UK National Nuclear Laboratory
notes: Noted as already in the GradCracker follows but had no state record before this register.

name: Dstl
notes: STRONGEST FIT IN THE CIVIL SERVICE TRACK. L6 degree apprenticeships across all STEM. GBP14,358-27,010. Confirmed pattern: recruits in February for the following September. Porton Down ~35mi. Requires UK national, no dual nationality, 5 years residency - all confirmed clear for Fraser (Aug 2026).

name: MI5, MI6 and GCHQ
notes: GCHQ Infrastructure Engineering Apprenticeship requires three A-level passes with two in STEM - Fraser's combination satisfies this cleanly. Software Engineering route wants 72 UCAS points + GCSE 4 in English and Maths. 2027 dates TBC. MI5/MI6 do not fit the engineering route.

name: British Army
notes: Rolling - no window to miss. Ammunition Technician (EOD/weapons), Intelligence Analyst, Network Engineer, Data Analyst. L4, GBP26,334. Military engineering route, separate category.

name: Royal Navy
notes: Rolling. ACCELERATED APPRENTICE SCHEME IS THE A-LEVEL ROUTE SPECIFICALLY - join as Probationary Leading Hand, two ranks above standard entry. Weapon or Air Engineering.

name: Royal Air Force
notes: Rolling. 23 apprenticeship roles. Note RAF pilot is a separate officer route, not an apprenticeship.

name: 3M
notes: Kept per Adam - diversified conglomerate, materials/chemical/mechanical mix.

name: Maersk
notes: Kept per Adam - marine/shipping engineering, separate sector.

name: Perenco
notes: Oil & gas extraction, but runs a Structural Engineering graduate programme specifically - closer to civil/structural than typical oil & gas. Master list open question: worth a closer look if it is a genuine fit.

name: OCU Group
notes: Utilities infrastructure services, but the listed role was Quantity Surveyor (commercial route).

name: Medical Research Council
notes: Biomedical research, not engineering.

name: Met Office
notes: NOT YET CHECKED. Exeter. Strong Physics fit - needs checking on their own careers page.

name: UK Space Agency
notes: NOT YET CHECKED. Strong Physics fit - needs checking on their own careers page.

name: HMRC
notes: Was bundled into a single four-organisation state record, so could not be tracked independently. Nothing found - absence of search evidence, not confirmed absence of a scheme.

name: DVSA
notes: Apprenticeships confirmed to exist; no STEM-specific roles or dates found.

name: Civil Service Career Launch
notes: ELIGIBILITY BLOCKER CONFIRMED - requires aged 16+ AND NOT IN FULL-TIME EDUCATION, so Fraser cannot apply while at school. Also only a Level 3 Business Administrator qualification (weak return on Maths/Physics/Chemistry) and Birmingham/Manchester/London only. Fallback, not a target.

name: Civil Service Fast Track
notes: Better fit than Career Launch (L4). Historically opens March-early April. VERIFY whether the not-in-full-time-education rule applies here too - that determines whether it is usable at all. Needs a registrations.md action item, which it currently lacks.
